title: One-Stop Digital Marketing Provider Duoxiangyun Passes HKEX Hearing — Plans Hong Kong IPO

html:
Unique Research · Company / IPO · November 3, 2022 · Full rewrite — not a stub

On Oct 22, 2022, Duoxiangyun / Many Idea Cloud (多想云) passed HKEX hearing (Zhongtai International sole sponsor). Use of proceeds: enrich SaaS interactive-marketing Content Engine templates + analytics; expand owned/third-party IP content & media; upgrade Beijing into #2 HQ and open tier-1/2 offices; M&A for supply/tech.

Founded Jun 10, 2021 (root Xiamen Duoxiang since 2012); 300+ KA logos (Liby, Hongxing Erke, FILA, JOMOO, Panpan…). Five lines: content marketing, SaaS interactive marketing, digital marketing, PR events, media ads. Content Engine: 300k SKU interactive templates, no-code drag-drop. Controllers Liu Jianhui (~20.4% + 19.7% via Xiamen Dream Future) and Qu Shuo.

Financials: rev ¥391M / ¥308M / ¥353M (’19–’21); NI ¥80M / ¥32M / ¥65M. 4M’22 rev ¥144M (+105% YoY), NI ¥15M (+222%). Content marketing >50% of rev (~63.7%→53.2%→57% early ’22). Charts/shareholding trees in CN images — attach on ingest.

— END —
